description: Records the reviewed service order and queues staff and customer confirmations after validation. Connected-building orders are accepted; eligible nearby commercial buildings receive conditional orders with status pending_survey. Before placing an order, show the actual customer the exact building, bandwidth, monthly price, installation fee, survey requirement where applicable, term and linked service terms. Nearby orders use the standard installation fee for the selected bandwidth from the published Dedicated Internet schedule. Explain that feasibility, installation scope and timing require a site survey; special construction or changes to the displayed price or terms require separate approval before work begins. Never promise the connected-building online installation offer or timing for a Nearby order. Obtain that customer’s explicit acceptance and confirmation that they are authorized to order for the company. Never infer consent or authority from an availability or pricing inquiry. Pass accept_terms=true and authorized_to_order=true only after that explicit customer confirmation. Retry the same order_token after a network failure; never prepare a new order just to retry. No payment is collected at checkout.

accept_terms.description: Set to true only after the actual customer explicitly accepts the reviewed service terms and charges.

authorized_to_order.description: Set to true only after the actual customer explicitly confirms authorization to place this order.

company.description: Legal or business name of the customer placing the order.

details.description: Optional customer-provided notes relevant to the order.

email.description: Customer contact email address for the order confirmation.

name.description: Name of the customer contact authorized to place the order.

order_token.description: Signed, time-limited order_token from prepare_order for the offer the customer reviewed.

phone.description: Customer contact telephone number for the order.

preferred_installation_date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date, 4 to 90 calendar days from today in America/New_York. Stealth confirms scheduling.

suite.description: Floor, suite, or other location within the selected building.

name: place_order
title: Place an explicitly approved Stealth service order
